method.inspection: Direct view_image inspection of every existing full-page PNG, in four batches of four pages.

page_reviews.checks: Title, authorship, date, abstract and beginning of introduction are clear. The abstract's common starting-scale sequence, compatible limits and finite joint distributions are legible. No title or paragraph overlap.
Introduction ends cleanly, including attribution of the orbit-minimum theorem to Tao. Three-clock definitions, Proposition 2.1 and equations (1)-(2) fit within margins.
Clock proof, example, harmonic sums, dyadic transport and finite-cutoff sampling are readable. Equations (3)-(4) and proposition headings are well placed.
Sampling proof, first-passage definitions and nested-passage lemma are readable. Dagger symbols and equation (5) render correctly.
Kernel identities, telescoping estimate and tightness theorem are clear. The final displayed equation remains above the footer without collision.
Tightness proof, power-error estimate, Tao input and unmerged first-passage law are readable. Equations (10)-(13) fit correctly.

New Section 4.1 and Corollary 4.2 fit cleanly on the page: common base, all-threshold laws, quantitative convergence, compatibility, failure bound and proof. Superscripts in the limiting-law notation render correctly. The common-base caveat at the bottom is legible and unobstructed.

New Corollary 4.3, compatible tuple space, definition of J and its bijection/isometry proof are legible. The bound independent of the number of thresholds is visible. Section 4.2 and its fixed-threshold equations fit without overlap.
Fixed-threshold proof and diverging-threshold corollary are readable. Proposition 4.6 begins cleanly; its enumerated list continues normally onto the following page.
Continuation of the enumerated proposition and its proof is clear. Endpoint/coefficient section, parameters, first subsection and multiplicative-buffer proposition have sound spacing.
Buffer proof and affine-coefficient expansion are clear. Equations (23)-(25), including the bottom display, remain inside the text area.
Uniform coefficient bound and proof are dense but legible. Equations (26)-(28) remain within margins and have adequate separation.
Proof continuation, sums, finite-modulus lift explanation and beginning of Section 6 are readable, with no page-break collision.
Reserve proposition, equation (30) and proof fit clearly. The discussion visibly uses the phrase 'exactly the retained reserve' and attributes the source reserve to Tao.

Dyadic/threshold discussion, five-row source-locator table, computational/authorship paragraphs and first two bibliography entries are readable. Table columns fit. The wrapped Allouche URL is not clipped.
Remaining bibliography entries (3)-(6), URLs and page number render clearly. The short final bibliography page is a normal ending, not a layout defect.
